name: zz-access
description: Access, yours and everybody's: your platform token, your keys for the building blocks, and the setup for whichever client you work in — plus, if your role carries them, the people, teams, flow installs and block grants behind them. One door; the tools you are offered are the ones your role can execute.
purpose: To be the one door for every credential and every question about who may do what — your platform token, your block keys, your client setup, and, if your role carries them, the people, teams, installs and grants behind them. A tool belongs here when it hands somebody a key or changes who holds one.
